segments.text: What rule hath God given for our direction in prayer
The whole Word of God is of use to direct us in prayer;
but the special rule of direction is that form of prayer which Christ taught his disciples, commonly called the Lord's Prayer.
Larger Catechism one hundred and eighty-six
What rule hath God given for our direction in the duty of prayer
The whole Word of God is of use to direct us in the duty of prayer;
but the special rule of direction is that form of prayer which our Savior Christ taught his disciples, commonly called the Lord's Prayer.
